dct_description_sm:
This dataset includes all of the voting places available to voters for the 2025 general election. The City of Vancouver uses a Vote-Anywhere model.​​ Since 2014, voters can vote at any voting place within the City.​​

​The City operates an at-large ​​voting system.​​

​​​​Advance voting days: March 26 and April 1, 2025

​​Election day: April 5, 2025

​​​​​​​Voting hours for all locations are 8am to 8pm.


Note

Residents of UBC and the University Endowment Lands were not eligible to vote in this by-election as there was no School Trustee contest.


Data currency

​​These are the voting places used for the ​City's 2025 local by-election during advance voting and on general voting day.​​
